'''2000 Hoth Ice Plains Regionals Alex Klammrodt Ice Plains Regional Winner LS''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Alex Klammrodt]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2000 Hoth Ice Plains Regionals]]. The post is titled 'Ice Plains Regional Winner LS' and says: "this deck went undefeated at the Ice Plains Regional, but it did lose against Yannick Lapointe's heavy manipulation deck in the finals." Description: "This deck took me through thick and thin at the regionals, winning all tourney games, as well leaving me with 6-0." (posted 10 July 2000; the regional was 9 July 2000).<ref name="dt-8307">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8307 Ice Plains Regional Winner LS], DeckTech (Alex "-AvataR-" Klammrodt, 10 July 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/8307/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/8307/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018152617/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8307/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Ice Plains Regional Winner LS'''
* '''Author:''' Alex "-AvataR-" Klammrodt
* '''Published:''' July 10, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This deck took me through thick and thin at the regionals, winning all tourney games, as well leaving me with 6-0.

=== Strategy ===

Again, this deck went undefeated at the Ice Plains Regional, but it did lose against Yannick Lapointe's heavy manipulation deck in the finals.

Really, this deck doesn't use a single strategy. Basically, it can setup fast or slow depending on how many chances you're willing to take. The heavy SAC gives you options and most of the other cards are pretty self-explanatory. Even if you think that one starship is not enough, I've gotta tell you it is. Big Blue is not the dominant meta here and SFS is nowhere to be seen, BUT if it did come down to it, I still think this deck would kick their asses Enjoy.
